description: RATCHET (cloister-17e502): orchestration-by-subprocess in cloister's JS execution runtime path must not grow. execution/v1 over UDS replaces it; the remaining sites are the compatibility fallback. Baseline 13 across compatibility-client, install-compatibility, runtime, runtime-storage-init. A ratchet not a ban, because zero is blocked on LLO publishing the contract — but every new spawn is a step away from the thing we are landing. Lower the baseline when you delete one; never raise it. ── WHAT COUNTS: fork-and-parse — spawning a child and reading its stdout/exit code to drive control flow. That is the shape execution/v1 replaces. ── THREE THINGS THIS DOES NOT COUNT, EACH FOR A DIFFERENT REASON (cloister-fb0b09). (1) rs/crates/host-runtime/src/krunvm.rs forks the krunvm CLI at two Command::new sites. NOT ratcheted, deliberately: ADR-0049's 2026-07-31 amendment already assigned that runtime to LLO — 'the current rs/crates/host-runtime and related tools/ code are compatibility migration sources, not the target architecture.' Its target count is zero by DELETION (cloister-5624e8), and a ratchet would put a floor under code that should leave. Do not add sites there either; it is on the way out. (2) tools/harness-sandbox/src/main.rs applies kernel confinement and then `exec`s — it replaces this process, never returns, and orchestrates nothing. A sandbox launcher is not a shell-out. (3) rosary/src/cloister_provider.rs:89 reaches cloister by forking the cloister BINARY and parsing its stdout. Above cloister's layer, ungateable from here, and rosary cannot stop until execution/v1 is an addressable surface it can call. ── Reaching 0 here proves cloister's JS runtime path is clean. It does NOT prove the rosary → cloister → LLO chain is de-shelled. Do not cite this rule as evidence that it is.
run: BASE=13; N=$(grep -rnE 'spawnSync|spawn\(|execSync|execFile' cli/lib/runtime cli/commands/runtime.mjs cli/commands/runtime-storage-init.mjs 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$N" -gt "$BASE" ]; then echo "runtime subprocess sites grew: $N > $BASE (baseline)"; grep -rnE 'spawnSync|spawn\(|execSync|execFile' cli/lib/runtime cli/commands/runtime.mjs cli/commands/runtime-storage-init.mjs; echo; echo 'Reach LLO through execution/v1 over UDS (cli/lib/runtime/llo-client.mjs), not a subprocess. Per ADR-0063.'; exit 1; fi; if [ "$N" -lt "$BASE" ]; then echo "ratchet loosened: $N < $BASE — lower BASE in this rule to $N to lock the win in"; exit 1; fi; echo "runtime subprocess sites: $N (at baseline) — see this rule's description for the three things it does NOT count"
